dde8101ad0.en: A read of the 2024 HKSTP Systems Engineering Workshop: international researchers on the dependability, reliability and trustworthiness of complex, AI-driven systems — from classical reliability modeling (RBD, fault trees, Markov chains) to safe learning, trustworthy & fair AI, and data-centric quality assurance for LLM systems. The running thread: systems engineering must be re-founded for software whose behavior is learned, not specified.

befb43cdb3.en: {1}About:{/1} Hosted by Hong Kong Science & Technology Parks (HKSTP), the workshop gathered systems- and software-engineering researchers on making complex intelligent systems dependable and trustworthy.
befb43cdb3.zh: {1}简介：{/1}研讨会由香港科技园公司（HKSTP）主办，汇聚系统工程与软件工程领域的研究者，探讨如何让复杂智能系统可依赖、可信赖。

d4e6d4fa42.en: Classical dependability tools are being combined with data-driven methods (LLMs, RL, Gaussian processes); distribution shift and uncertainty recur across control, testing and LLM talks; and trustworthiness — safety, reliability, fairness, explainability — is treated as the gate for deploying AI.
d4e6d4fa42.zh: 经典的可依赖性工具正与数据驱动方法（LLM、RL、高斯过程）相结合；分布偏移和不确定性反复出现在控制、测试和 LLM 的报告中；可信赖性——安全、可靠、公平、可解释——被视为部署 AI 的关卡。

10dee3cd10.en: Reliability & Availability Modeling of Complex Systems in Practice
10dee3cd10.zh: Reliability & Availability Modeling of Complex Systems in Practice

a5642411d4.en: {1}Dependability modeling{/1} · RBD · fault trees · Markov chains
a5642411d4.zh: {1}可依赖性建模{/1} · RBD · 故障树 · 马尔可夫链

b939cc98ff.en: Dependability = justified reliance on the delivered service; a taxonomy of Attributes (availability, reliability, safety, maintainability), Means and Threats
b939cc98ff.zh: 可依赖性 = 对所提供服务的合理依赖；其分类包括属性（可用性、可靠性、安全性、可维护性）、手段和威胁

13d1cba2ed.en: The causal chain Fault → Error → Failure
13d1cba2ed.zh: 因果链：故障（Fault）→ 错误（Error）→ 失效（Failure）

5c0e85940d.en: Four means: fault prevention, removal (debugging), tolerance (redundancy), forecasting
5c0e85940d.zh: 四种手段：故障预防、故障排除（调试）、故障容忍（冗余）、故障预测

ecb7afd08c.en: Data-driven vs model-driven paths; discrete-event vs analytic simulation; prefer a numerical solution over simulation when feasible
ecb7afd08c.zh: 数据驱动与模型驱动两条路径；离散事件仿真与解析仿真；可行时优先采用数值解而非仿真

367e2da80f.en: Complexity dimensions: huge models (100s–1000s of components), user-oriented measures, non-exponential distributions (SMP, MRGP), performability
367e2da80f.zh: 复杂性维度：庞大的模型（100–1000 个以上组件）、面向用户的度量、非指数分布（SMP、MRGP）、可表现性

45e9399224.en: Simple methods (RBD, fault trees, reliability graphs) assume independence — fast but miss dependencies (shared repair, spares, imperfect coverage)
45e9399224.zh: 简单方法（RBD、故障树、可靠性图）假设相互独立——速度快，但会漏掉依赖关系（共享维修、备件、不完全覆盖）

dc5de467f5.en: State-space methods (DTMC/CTMC, SMP, phase-type) capture dependency but explode; mitigate via hierarchical composition or fixed-point iteration
dc5de467f5.zh: 状态空间方法（DTMC/CTMC、SMP、相型分布）能刻画依赖关系，但会爆炸；可通过分层组合或不动点迭代缓解

726f6c9449.zh: 案例研究 — IBM HA SIP

27425fb495.en: A high-availability SIP system on IBM BladeCenter + WebSphere for a telco customer
27425fb495.zh: 为电信客户在 IBM BladeCenter + WebSphere 上构建的高可用 SIP 系统

aaf696506c.en: Quantify steady-state availability and a user-oriented DPM (defects-per-million) metric
aaf696506c.zh: 量化稳态可用性和面向用户的 DPM（每百万缺陷数）指标

c105c6f331.en: Quantitative dependability assessment — data-driven and model-driven paths to a numerical reliability solution.
c105c6f331.zh: 定量可依赖性评估——通过数据驱动和模型驱动两条路径得到数值化的可靠性解。

6c09062f55.en: Early Detection of Degraded Systems: Self-Healing with Time Delay
6c09062f55.zh: Early Detection of Degraded Systems: Self-Healing with Time Delay

c4dddc1c0f.en: Many systems degrade rather than fail outright; the danger is a degraded-but-undetected state revealed only after a random delay
c4dddc1c0f.zh: 许多系统是逐渐退化而不是直接失效；危险在于处于退化但未被检测到的状态，只有经过随机延迟后才会暴露

c9e2389d6a.en: Scale: a 10,000-machine data center sees ~1,000 crashes/day; ~4% of machines hit undetected errors (Google)
c9e2389d6a.zh: 规模：一个 10,000 台机器的数据中心每天约有 1,000 次崩溃；约 4% 的机器遇到未被检测到的错误（Google）

d85071b63a.en: Reliability R(t) = P1(t) + P2(t): operating normally OR degraded-but-undetected; availability sums the available states
d85071b63a.zh: 可靠性 R(t) = P1(t) + P2(t)：正常运行，或处于退化但未被检测的状态；可用性是各可用状态之和

b4f0934d60.en: A self-healing / self-repair state diagram with delayed, dependent transitions (Pham, IEEE Trans. Reliability, 2024)
b4f0934d60.zh: 带有延迟、相互依赖转移的自修复 / 自我修复状态图（Pham，IEEE Trans. Reliability，2024）

bd5fb71e39.en: Models Healthy cells (H), Infected cells (I) and Virus (V) with delayed transitions — a self-healing analogy
bd5fb71e39.zh: 用带延迟的转移为健康细胞（H）、感染细胞（I）和病毒（V）建模——一种自修复类比

deed8fc279.en: A self-healing / self-repair state diagram with delayed, dependent degradation and recovery transitions.
deed8fc279.zh: 带有延迟、相互依赖的退化与恢复转移的自修复 / 自我修复状态图。

b3484f57ef.en: {1}W. Eric Wong{/1} · University of Texas at Dallas
b3484f57ef.zh: {1}W. Eric Wong{/1} · University of Texas at Dallas

5fe35225de.en: Security attributes differ from reliability (vulnerability vs probability of failure-free operation)
5fe35225de.zh: 安全属性不同于可靠性（脆弱性与无故障运行概率）

951efdf3dd.en: Combine Combinatorial Testing with Reliability-Block-Diagram structure and Boundary Value Analysis to generate efficient test cases
951efdf3dd.zh: 将组合测试与可靠性框图结构和边界值分析相结合，生成高效的测试用例

c42da18173.en: Across packages, combinatorial coverage finds more — and different — bugs with fewer test cases than exhaustive runs
c42da18173.zh: 在各个软件包上，组合覆盖比穷举运行用更少的测试用例发现更多且不同的缺陷

7630aef2df.en: Claimed ~50% less development and ~90% less maintenance effort for autonomous-system assurance
7630aef2df.zh: 据称自主系统保障的开发工作量减少约 50%，维护工作量减少约 90%

8bcca5ae7b.en: Effectiveness hinges on input-space model quality: number of parameters, values per parameter, cases generated, bugs detected
8bcca5ae7b.zh: 效果取决于输入空间模型的质量：参数个数、每个参数的取值数、生成的用例数、检出的缺陷数

6ad9f3e53a.en: AV example: primary vs backup sensors, emergency braking, ‘abnormal sensor’ cases, sun glare, and expansion paths
6ad9f3e53a.zh: 自动驾驶示例：主传感器与备用传感器、紧急制动、‘传感器异常’场景、太阳眩光以及扩展路径

b9e0fcbcbb.en: Combinatorial-testing bug-detection results — fewer test cases catching more (and different) bugs.
b9e0fcbcbb.zh: 组合测试的缺陷检测结果——用更少的测试用例发现更多（且不同的）缺陷。

7b9ffed206.zh: AI 失败 → 形式化方法

c349ce4528.en: AI has big wins but costly, unexplained failures (Knight Capital, Microsoft Tay, Tesla/Amazon incidents)
c349ce4528.zh: AI 成果显著，但失败代价高昂且无法解释（Knight Capital、Microsoft Tay、Tesla / Amazon 事件）

fb6be23a11.en: Model checking works: 2007 ACM Turing Award; Microsoft SLAM finds Windows driver bugs; the PAT toolkit has 400k+ downloads
fb6be23a11.zh: 模型检测行之有效：2007 年 ACM 图灵奖；Microsoft SLAM 发现 Windows 驱动程序缺陷；PAT 工具包下载量超过 400k

469d336580.en: PMC computes system reliability from component reliability; here applied to sports-winning probability
469d336580.zh: PMC 由组件可靠性计算系统可靠性；此处应用于体育比赛的获胜概率

25bf2de5ef.en: ‘Tennis strategy is an MDP’ (ICDCS 2015): compute winning probability and the optimal strategy
25bf2de5ef.zh: ‘网球策略是一个 MDP’（ICDCS 2015）：计算获胜概率和最优策略

86c4e7340f.en: A GPT-4 sports-analytics pipeline: video statistics → vision-language extraction → model processor → outcome prediction and strategy
86c4e7340f.zh: 一条 GPT-4 体育分析流水线：视频统计 → 视觉语言提取 → 模型处理器 → 结果预测与策略

503becfc2d.en: An LLM / GPT-4 sports-analytics pipeline: video statistics → extraction → model → winning probability & strategy.
503becfc2d.zh: 一条 LLM / GPT-4 体育分析流水线：视频统计 → 提取 → 模型 → 获胜概率与策略。

5df6c493a7.en: From Trustworthy Systems to Trustworthy AI
5df6c493a7.zh: From Trustworthy Systems to Trustworthy AI

8203d31fa6.zh: {1}Xin Yao{/1} · 可信与进化式 AI

84baf8c5c7.en: Trust and trustworthiness are asymmetrically bidirectional, context-dependent and learnable
84baf8c5c7.zh: 信任与可信赖性是不对称的双向关系，依赖于情境，并且可以学习

ee33e3bef6.en: Six attributes of trustworthy systems: resilience, security, privacy, safety, reliability, availability
ee33e3bef6.zh: 可信赖系统的六项属性：韧性、安全性（security）、隐私、安全性（safety）、可靠性、可用性

6553fb5d1e.en: AI ethics is hierarchical (individual / society / environment); map each principle to a technique — transparency→explainable AI, fairness→fair AI, non-maleficence→safe/robust AI, privacy→federated/differential learning
6553fb5d1e.zh: AI 伦理是分层的（个人 / 社会 / 环境）；将每项原则对应到一种技术——透明性→可解释 AI，公平性→公平 AI，不作恶→安全 / 鲁棒 AI，隐私→联邦 / 差分学习

f1c7b298f9.en: 20+ fairness metrics in five families; feature-attribution explanations judged by faithfulness, sensitivity and complexity
f1c7b298f9.zh: 5 大类共 20 多种公平性度量；特征归因解释按忠实性、敏感性和复杂度来评判

8a579d5f9b.en: A multi-objective evolutionary method (MOFAE) optimizes explanations across metrics; evolutionary constrained learning regulates ML behavior
8a579d5f9b.zh: 一种多目标进化方法（MOFAE）在多个度量上优化解释；进化式约束学习用于调控 ML 行为

4506f65bac.en: Evolutionary computation is a promising engine for fair, explainable and safe AI
4506f65bac.zh: 进化计算是实现公平、可解释和安全 AI 的有前景的引擎

ed42fe89ae.en: AI ethics as a hierarchical, multi-dimensional map from principles to research directions.
ed42fe89ae.zh: AI 伦理：从原则到研究方向的分层、多维图谱。

7310657bd7.en: Data-centric Quality Assurance for AI & LLM Systems
7310657bd7.zh: Data-centric Quality Assurance for AI & LLM Systems

1bd944f6d4.zh: {1}Fujitsu / SEI{/1} · 以数据为中心的 AI 质量保证

2fb8284084.zh: 一种新的 AI 系统范式

eee5821fe7.en: Modern AI systems combine 30+ AI models and 50+ traditional components (e.g. STT → NLP intent → response generation → TTS); a ‘Universal AI-CPS’ on NVIDIA Omniverse
eee5821fe7.zh: 现代 AI 系统结合了 30 多个 AI 模型和 50 多个传统组件（例如 STT → NLP 意图 → 响应生成 → TTS）；基于 NVIDIA Omniverse 的 ‘Universal AI-CPS’

bbb9b8c49e.en: ISR-LLM: an iterative self-refined LLM for long-horizon task planning (ICRA 2024)
bbb9b8c49e.zh: ISR-LLM：用于长时程任务规划的迭代自我精炼 LLM（ICRA 2024）

7dbbe674e7.en: Behavior is learned, not specified → explainability is key and new QA methods are needed
7dbbe674e7.zh: 行为是学习得到的，而非预先规定的 → 可解释性至关重要，需要新的质量保证方法

aba9c81fb9.en: Unit level: quality across the ML lifecycle; DeepGauge test-coverage criteria; data-centric out-of-distribution & uncertainty analysis
aba9c81fb9.zh: 单元层面：贯穿 ML 生命周期的质量；DeepGauge 测试覆盖准则；以数据为中心的分布外与不确定性分析

31ca5186b2.en: System level: quality assurance and reliability support at integration and system stages
31ca5186b2.zh: 系统层面：在集成和系统阶段提供质量保证和可靠性支持

eb77451739.en: Human-centered, explainable MLSysOps across data, model, code and system
eb77451739.zh: 跨数据、模型、代码和系统的以人为中心、可解释的 MLSysOps

e9c6bc4626.en: LLM trustworthiness is at a very early stage; internals are hard to test and debug
e9c6bc4626.zh: LLM 的可信赖性尚处于非常早期的阶段；其内部机制难以测试和调试

0a0da43ac0.en: Tools: the LUNA model-analysis framework; LLM-agent orchestration decomposed into Profile, Memory, Planning and Action
0a0da43ac0.zh: 工具：LUNA 模型分析框架；将大语言模型智能体编排分解为 Profile、Memory、Planning 和 Action

5617632fed.en: LLM-agent orchestration as a complex system — Profile, Memory, Planning and Action modules.
5617632fed.zh: 作为复杂系统的大语言模型智能体编排——Profile、Memory、Planning 和 Action 模块。

3674ec02f3.en: A formal abstract system S ≜ (C, B, Rᶜ, Rᵇ, Rᶠ, Rⁱ, Rᵒ): components, behaviors and internal/external relation sets
3674ec02f3.zh: 形式化抽象系统 S ≜ (C, B, Rᶜ, Rᵇ, Rᶠ, Rⁱ, Rᵒ)：组件、行为以及内部 / 外部关系集

6be8400bf2.en: Abstract intelligence transfers information / knowledge into behavior
6be8400bf2.zh: 抽象智能将信息 / 知识转化为行为

9565e52263.en: System autonomy by cognitive × behavioral axes: reflexive, imperative, adaptive, autonomous — autonomous intelligence is the 4th (quaternary) level
9565e52263.zh: 按认知 × 行为两个维度划分的系统自主性：反射式、命令式、自适应、自主——自主智能是第 4 级（四元）水平

fda3f3f4e2.en: Machine thinking via LRMB (Layered Reference Model of the Brain): sensation, action, perception, memory, cognition, inference, intelligence
fda3f3f4e2.zh: 通过 LRMB（Layered Reference Model of the Brain，大脑分层参考模型）实现机器思维：感觉、行动、感知、记忆、认知、推断、智能

a9b6085835.en: A tripartite model: structural, behavioral and dynamic trustworthiness
a9b6085835.zh: 一种三方模型：结构可信赖性、行为可信赖性和动态可信赖性

6a03961dfa.en: A formal model links levels of system intelligence by inclusion
6a03961dfa.zh: 一个形式化模型通过包含关系把各级系统智能联系起来

98146c5b8f.en: The tripartite model of autonomous-system trustworthiness — structural, behavioral, dynamic.
98146c5b8f.zh: 自主系统可信赖性的三方模型——结构、行为、动态。

ba5321e2cd.en: Ensuring Reliability of Autonomous Vehicular Systems
ba5321e2cd.zh: Ensuring Reliability of Autonomous Vehicular Systems

6de3b4dadb.en: {1}Jianping Wang{/1} · City University of Hong Kong
6de3b4dadb.zh: {1}Jianping Wang{/1} · City University of Hong Kong

0ad1bbc25e.en: The AD stack on a driving OS (Apollo 3.5/5.0): perception → localization → prediction → planning → control
0ad1bbc25e.zh: 运行在驾驶操作系统上的自动驾驶栈（Apollo 3.5/5.0）：感知 → 定位 → 预测 → 规划 → 控制

5fd71ca1d8.en: Vulnerabilities: perception-model uncertainty, dynamic per-module compute time, and adverse weather (fog/rain/snow degrade cameras, LiDAR and comms)
5fd71ca1d8.zh: 脆弱性：感知模型的不确定性、各模块动态变化的计算时间，以及恶劣天气（雾 / 雨 / 雪会削弱摄像头、LiDAR 和通信）

4abf6dddcf.en: Hardware limits → edge computing; software (model uncertainty, timing) → digital twins & cooperative sensing
4abf6dddcf.zh: 硬件限制 → 边缘计算；软件（模型不确定性、时序）→ 数字孪生与协同感知

469b029589.en: Attacks (physical / adversarial / cyber) → robust driving; adverse weather → robust V2X
469b029589.zh: 攻击（物理 / 对抗 / 网络）→ 鲁棒驾驶；恶劣天气 → 鲁棒 V2X

869dd6cb6d.en: Adversarial-attack-aware motion planning stays safe where naive planning fails; multi-agent prediction + camera/LiDAR/radar fusion handle occlusion
869dd6cb6d.zh: 具备对抗攻击感知能力的运动规划在朴素规划失效的情况下仍保持安全；多智能体预测 + 摄像头 / LiDAR / 雷达融合可应对遮挡

65ca06e27f.en: Onboard scheduling uses an Age-of-Information metric and an RL agent (reward ∝ 1/AoI), improving miss ratio and response vs Apollo baselines
65ca06e27f.zh: 车载调度使用信息年龄（Age-of-Information）指标和 RL 智能体（奖励 ∝ 1/AoI），相比 Apollo 基线改善了错过率和响应

a90a4ec4f8.en: Countermeasures mapped to AV vulnerabilities — edge computing, digital twins, cooperative sensing, robust V2X.
a90a4ec4f8.zh: 与自动驾驶车辆脆弱性对应的应对措施——边缘计算、数字孪生、协同感知、鲁棒 V2X。

30f632b623.en: Safety-critical systems need guarantees because failures can be deadly; safely obtaining training data is hard
30f632b623.zh: 安全关键系统需要保证，因为失效可能致命；而安全地获取训练数据很困难

cb45417387.en: Control-theoretic tools (structured, deterministic) are strong on safety/robustness; ML tools (general, stochastic) are strong on empirical performance
cb45417387.zh: 控制理论工具（结构化、确定性）在安全 / 鲁棒性上很强；ML 工具（通用、随机性）在经验性能上很强

0da918c136.en: Train-vs-real distribution shift can break the control objective; control the size of the guaranteed set, or be agnostic to the training distribution
0da918c136.zh: 训练与真实分布之间的偏移可能破坏控制目标；可控制有保证集合的大小，或对训练分布保持无关

868e558f06.en: Distributionally robust optimization with finite samples; verified by Monte-Carlo; incremental stochastic stability
868e558f06.zh: 有限样本下的分布鲁棒优化；通过蒙特卡洛验证；增量随机稳定性

0f41d0e84b.zh: L1 自适应控制 + 学习

e5abaea1f0.en: L1 adaptive control gives guaranteed uniform performance bounds, decoupling estimation from control (small-gain + Lyapunov)
e5abaea1f0.zh: L1 自适应控制给出有保证的一致性能界，将估计与控制解耦（小增益 + Lyapunov）

6a21b98035.en: Commercialized with NASA, Caterpillar and JOUAV; extended via contraction metrics, L1-MPC, and contraction-L1 with Gaussian-process learning
6a21b98035.zh: 已与 NASA、Caterpillar 和 JOUAV 合作实现商业化；并通过收缩度量、L1-MPC 以及结合高斯过程学习的 contraction-L1 得到扩展

196e59dc11.en: Control-theoretic tools (safety & robustness) versus data-driven ML tools (empirical performance).
196e59dc11.zh: 控制理论工具（安全与鲁棒性）与数据驱动的 ML 工具（经验性能）的对比。

d2bcdc31e1.en: An integrated multi-physics, multi-scale, probabilistic simulation updated by sensors (NASA 2012); a digital replica that improves decision-making (CDBB 2018)
d2bcdc31e1.zh: 由传感器更新的集成式多物理场、多尺度、概率仿真（NASA 2012）；能改进决策的数字副本（CDBB 2018）

ae8228d084.en: A twin should see, learn, think, act, communicate, cooperate and achieve
ae8228d084.zh: 孪生体应当能看、学、思、行、沟通、协作并达成目标

38002692f5.en: Connected assets help each other ‘in times of trouble’ via shared information / computation — faster, coordinated recovery
38002692f5.zh: 互联资产通过共享信息 / 计算在‘危难之时’互相帮助——更快、更协调的恢复

91771d3683.en: Spans robotics, AI, V2X, perception and blockchain across cyber-physical and cyber-cyber systems
91771d3683.zh: 涵盖机器人、AI、V2X、感知和区块链，跨越信息物理系统与信息—信息系统

b782e1de12.en: Japan’s FUKUI self-driving public transit; an Oct 2023 incident where an AV failed to stop and collided, triggering new safety measures
b782e1de12.zh: 日本福井的自动驾驶公共交通；2023 年 10 月一起自动驾驶车辆未能停车并发生碰撞的事故，促使出台新的安全措施

3cedb1d066.en: Collaborative digital twins helping each other recover ‘in times of trouble’.
3cedb1d066.zh: 协作式数字孪生在‘危难之时’互相帮助恢复。

ad64116f12.en: Artificial Intuition, Research Portfolios & Decision Systems
ad64116f12.zh: Artificial Intuition, Research Portfolios & Decision Systems

012ecdf7bc.en: An NLP pipeline compiles and augments abstracts, clusters research portfolios, then evaluates clusters and removes redundancy
012ecdf7bc.zh: 一条 NLP 流水线汇编并扩充摘要，对研究组合进行聚类，然后评估聚类并去除冗余

5bbb267ae1.en: Pipeline: documents → YAKE keywords → Mistral-7B metadata → Sentence-Transformer embeddings → labeled clusters (optics, flight system, remote sensing…)
5bbb267ae1.zh: 流水线：文档 → YAKE 关键词 → Mistral-7B 元数据 → Sentence-Transformer 嵌入 → 带标签的聚类（光学、飞行系统、遥感……）

eefde838ef.en: Too few clusters = poor coverage; too many = overlap
eefde838ef.zh: 聚类太少 = 覆盖不足；太多 = 重叠

5b4f99c85b.en: A new redundancy measure R = max cosine similarity between label vectors, plotted vs the number of clusters to pick the knee
5b4f99c85b.zh: 一种新的冗余度量 R = 标签向量之间的最大余弦相似度，随聚类数量作图以选取拐点

558a2b3fce.en: A k×ĉ coverage matrix yields coverage scores / predicted labels when similarity exceeds a threshold (MMR)
558a2b3fce.zh: k×ĉ 覆盖矩阵在相似度超过阈值（MMR）时给出覆盖分数 / 预测标签

4eb80af20b.en: An NLP portfolio pipeline — YAKE + Mistral-7B + Sentence-Transformer → clustering → coverage labels.
4eb80af20b.zh: 一条 NLP 研究组合流水线——YAKE + Mistral-7B + Sentence-Transformer → 聚类 → 覆盖标签。

25719b91e2.en: Classical dependability tools (RBD, fault trees, Markov chains, combinatorial testing, probabilistic model checking) are being combined with data-driven methods — not replaced.
25719b91e2.zh: 经典可依赖性工具（RBD、故障树、马尔可夫链、组合测试、概率模型检测）正与数据驱动方法结合，而不是被取代。

b7a6a3e6b8.en: Distribution shift and uncertainty quantification recur across the control, testing and LLM talks.
b7a6a3e6b8.zh: 分布偏移和不确定性量化反复出现在控制、测试和 LLM 的报告中。

8213b14d35.en: Autonomous driving is the shared case study grounding abstract reliability and safety methods.
8213b14d35.zh: 自动驾驶是共同的案例研究，使抽象的可靠性和安全方法落到实处。

6189da56b1.en: Trustworthiness — resilience, security, privacy, safety, reliability, availability, fairness, explainability — is the gate for deploying AI.
6189da56b1.zh: 可信赖性——韧性、安全性（security）、隐私、安全性（safety）、可靠性、可用性、公平性、可解释性——是部署 AI 的关卡。

8bc3ec7b81.en: Self-aware, cooperative systems: self-healing degradation, cognitive autonomy models, and collaborative digital twins.
8bc3ec7b81.zh: 具备自我感知的协作系统：退化的自修复、认知自主模型，以及协作式数字孪生。

5735bab0f2.en: Formal and guaranteed methods (L1 control, model checking) scaled to data-driven systems.
5735bab0f2.zh: 把形式化和有保证的方法（L1 控制、模型检测）扩展到数据驱动系统。

7a4e6485cf.en: Treat explainability and formal / guaranteed methods as prerequisites, not add-ons (L1 guarantees, PAT/SLAM, DeepGauge, LUNA).
7a4e6485cf.zh: 把可解释性以及形式化 / 有保证的方法视为前提，而不是附加项（L1 保证、PAT/SLAM、DeepGauge、LUNA）。

db215bffb3.en: Govern the ML lifecycle with data-centric quality assurance and out-of-distribution analysis.
db215bffb3.zh: 通过以数据为中心的质量保证和分布外分析来治理 ML 生命周期。

b0d88e6399.en: GenAI / LLM assurance is immature — the biggest open frontier is testing agentic systems whose behavior is learned, not specified.
b0d88e6399.zh: GenAI / LLM 保障尚不成熟——最大的未解前沿是测试行为由学习获得而非预先规定的智能体系统。

322805c821.en:
Trends

  • Classical dependability tools (RBD, fault trees, Markov chains, combinatorial testing, probabilistic model checking) are being combined with data-driven methods — not replaced.
  • Distribution shift and uncertainty quantification recur across the control, testing and LLM talks.
  • Autonomous driving is the shared case study grounding abstract reliability and safety methods.

Vision

  • Trustworthiness — resilience, security, privacy, safety, reliability, availability, fairness, explainability — is the gate for deploying AI.
  • Self-aware, cooperative systems: self-healing degradation, cognitive autonomy models, and collaborative digital twins.
  • Formal and guaranteed methods (L1 control, model checking) scaled to data-driven systems.

Implications for us

  • Treat explainability and formal / guaranteed methods as prerequisites, not add-ons (L1 guarantees, PAT/SLAM, DeepGauge, LUNA).
  • Govern the ML lifecycle with data-centric quality assurance and out-of-distribution analysis.
  • GenAI / LLM assurance is immature — the biggest open frontier is testing agentic systems whose behavior is learned, not specified.
322805c821.zh:
趋势

  • 经典可依赖性工具（RBD、故障树、马尔可夫链、组合测试、概率模型检测）正与数据驱动方法结合，而不是被取代。
  • 分布偏移和不确定性量化反复出现在控制、测试和 LLM 的报告中。
  • 自动驾驶是共同的案例研究，使抽象的可靠性和安全方法落到实处。

愿景

  • 可信赖性——韧性、安全性（security）、隐私、安全性（safety）、可靠性、可用性、公平性、可解释性——是部署 AI 的关卡。
  • 具备自我感知的协作系统：退化的自修复、认知自主模型，以及协作式数字孪生。
  • 把形式化和有保证的方法（L1 控制、模型检测）扩展到数据驱动系统。

对我们的启示

  • 把可解释性以及形式化 / 有保证的方法视为前提，而不是附加项（L1 保证、PAT/SLAM、DeepGauge、LUNA）。
  • 通过以数据为中心的质量保证和分布外分析来治理 ML 生命周期。
  • GenAI / LLM 保障尚不成熟——最大的未解前沿是测试行为由学习获得而非预先规定的智能体系统。

441cd4f954.en: About: Hosted by Hong Kong Science & Technology Parks (HKSTP), the workshop gathered systems- and software-engineering researchers on making complex intelligent systems dependable and trustworthy.
441cd4f954.zh: 简介：研讨会由香港科技园公司（HKSTP）主办，汇聚系统工程与软件工程领域的研究者，探讨如何让复杂智能系统可依赖、可信赖。

92b2173a39.zh: 洞察 01 · 可依赖性与可靠性建模

4e7c748e5e.en: Dependability modeling · RBD · fault trees · Markov chains
4e7c748e5e.zh: 可依赖性建模 · RBD · 故障树 · 马尔可夫链

0d305e52e4.en: • Dependability = justified reliance on the delivered service; a taxonomy of Attributes (availability, reliability, safety, maintainability), Means and Threats
0d305e52e4.zh: • 可依赖性 = 对所提供服务的合理依赖；其分类包括属性（可用性、可靠性、安全性、可维护性）、手段和威胁

299200183a.en: • The causal chain Fault → Error → Failure
299200183a.zh: • 因果链：故障（Fault）→ 错误（Error）→ 失效（Failure）

358e3fa9f1.en: • Four means: fault prevention, removal (debugging), tolerance (redundancy), forecasting
358e3fa9f1.zh: • 四种手段：故障预防、故障消除（调试）、故障容忍（冗余）、故障预测

a18148e7eb.en: • Data-driven vs model-driven paths; discrete-event vs analytic simulation; prefer a numerical solution over simulation when feasible
a18148e7eb.zh: • 数据驱动与模型驱动路径；离散事件仿真与解析仿真；在可行时优先采用数值解而非仿真

64afffc084.en: • Complexity dimensions: huge models (100s–1000s of components), user-oriented measures, non-exponential distributions (SMP, MRGP), performability
64afffc084.zh: • 复杂性维度：超大模型（数百至数千个组件）、面向用户的度量、非指数分布（SMP、MRGP）、可执行性（performability）

7c940c7bc6.en: • Simple methods (RBD, fault trees, reliability graphs) assume independence — fast but miss dependencies (shared repair, spares, imperfect coverage)
7c940c7bc6.zh: • 简单方法（RBD、故障树、可靠性图）假设相互独立，速度快，但无法体现依赖关系（共享维修、备件、不完全覆盖）

8e7591208c.en: • State-space methods (DTMC/CTMC, SMP, phase-type) capture dependency but explode; mitigate via hierarchical composition or fixed-point iteration
8e7591208c.zh: • 状态空间方法（DTMC/CTMC、SMP、phase-type）能刻画依赖关系，但会发生状态爆炸；可通过分层组合或不动点迭代缓解

52dfad9901.zh: 案例研究 — IBM HA SIP

c529ac833a.en: • A high-availability SIP system on IBM BladeCenter + WebSphere for a telco customer
c529ac833a.zh: • 面向电信客户、基于 IBM BladeCenter + WebSphere 的高可用 SIP 系统

ddaf43b87a.en: • Quantify steady-state availability and a user-oriented DPM (defects-per-million) metric
ddaf43b87a.zh: • 量化稳态可用性，以及面向用户的 DPM（每百万缺陷数）指标

51bc129568.zh: 洞察 02 · 可依赖性与可靠性建模

7284dc2f22.en: • Many systems degrade rather than fail outright; the danger is a degraded-but-undetected state revealed only after a random delay
7284dc2f22.zh: • 许多系统是逐步退化而不是直接失效；危险在于处于退化但未被检测到的状态，经过一段随机延迟后才暴露

35eda9e056.en: • Scale: a 10,000-machine data center sees ~1,000 crashes/day; ~4% of machines hit undetected errors (Google)
35eda9e056.zh: • 规模：一个拥有 10,000 台机器的数据中心每天约发生 1,000 次崩溃；约 4% 的机器遇到未被检测到的错误（Google）

1577944ed9.en: • Reliability R(t) = P1(t) + P2(t): operating normally OR degraded-but-undetected; availability sums the available states
1577944ed9.zh: • 可靠度 R(t) = P1(t) + P2(t)：正常运行，或处于退化但未被检测到的状态；可用度为各可用状态之和

93dd27ef0f.en: • A self-healing / self-repair state diagram with delayed, dependent transitions (Pham, IEEE Trans. Reliability, 2024)
93dd27ef0f.zh: • 带有延迟且相互依赖转移的自愈/自修复状态图（Pham, IEEE Trans. Reliability, 2024）

b57d290e6b.en: • Models Healthy cells (H), Infected cells (I) and Virus (V) with delayed transitions — a self-healing analogy
b57d290e6b.zh: • 用带延迟转移的模型描述健康细胞（H）、感染细胞（I）和病毒（V），这是一种自愈类比

bc7f5a5c13.zh: 洞察 03 · 测试、验证与形式化方法

9a2d9b7cd3.en: W. Eric Wong · University of Texas at Dallas
9a2d9b7cd3.zh: W. Eric Wong · University of Texas at Dallas

54dbc6eb6c.en: • Security attributes differ from reliability (vulnerability vs probability of failure-free operation)
54dbc6eb6c.zh: • 安全属性不同于可靠性（脆弱性与无失效运行的概率）

1f20c15095.en: • Combine Combinatorial Testing with Reliability-Block-Diagram structure and Boundary Value Analysis to generate efficient test cases
1f20c15095.zh: • 将组合测试（Combinatorial Testing）与可靠性框图（Reliability-Block-Diagram）结构和边界值分析（Boundary Value Analysis）结合，生成高效的测试用例

93fcc8f26c.en: • Across packages, combinatorial coverage finds more — and different — bugs with fewer test cases than exhaustive runs
93fcc8f26c.zh: • 在多个软件包上，组合覆盖用比穷举运行更少的测试用例，发现了更多且不同的缺陷

2762ebe427.en: • Claimed ~50% less development and ~90% less maintenance effort for autonomous-system assurance
2762ebe427.zh: • 宣称自主系统保障可减少约 50% 的开发工作量和约 90% 的维护工作量

27e20ba839.en: • Effectiveness hinges on input-space model quality: number of parameters, values per parameter, cases generated, bugs detected
27e20ba839.zh: • 效果取决于输入空间模型的质量：参数个数、每个参数的取值个数、生成的用例数、检出的缺陷数

9b2568e5e7.en: • AV example: primary vs backup sensors, emergency braking, ‘abnormal sensor’ cases, sun glare, and expansion paths
9b2568e5e7.zh: • 自动驾驶示例：主传感器与备用传感器、紧急制动、“异常传感器”用例、太阳眩光，以及扩展路径

532ce358b7.zh: 洞察 04 · 测试、验证与形式化方法

4c3db12853.en: Jin-Song Dong · National University of Singapore
4c3db12853.zh: Jin-Song Dong · National University of Singapore

cbb804e112.zh: AI 失败 → 形式化方法

6d5d13f0a2.en: • AI has big wins but costly, unexplained failures (Knight Capital, Microsoft Tay, Tesla/Amazon incidents)
6d5d13f0a2.zh: • AI 取得了巨大成功，但也出现了代价高昂、无法解释的失败（Knight Capital、Microsoft Tay、Tesla/Amazon 事故）

5551226226.en: • Model checking works: 2007 ACM Turing Award; Microsoft SLAM finds Windows driver bugs; the PAT toolkit has 400k+ downloads
5551226226.zh: • 模型检测行之有效：2007 年 ACM 图灵奖；Microsoft SLAM 可发现 Windows 驱动缺陷；PAT 工具包下载量超过 40 万次

ab93d37bf6.en: • PMC computes system reliability from component reliability; here applied to sports-winning probability
ab93d37bf6.zh: • PMC 根据组件可靠度计算系统可靠度；此处应用于体育比赛的获胜概率

0ea4ee457c.en: • ‘Tennis strategy is an MDP’ (ICDCS 2015): compute winning probability and the optimal strategy
0ea4ee457c.zh: • “网球策略是一个 MDP”（ICDCS 2015）：计算获胜概率和最优策略

4d3f3a18b3.en: • A GPT-4 sports-analytics pipeline: video statistics → vision-language extraction → model processor → outcome prediction and strategy
4d3f3a18b3.zh: • 一条 GPT-4 体育分析流水线：视频统计 → 视觉语言提取 → 模型处理器 → 结果预测与策略

4dcf23873e.zh: 洞察 05 · 可信与认知 AI

0088ee621e.zh: Xin Yao · 可信与进化式 AI

6fa7fe0ab3.en: • Trust and trustworthiness are asymmetrically bidirectional, context-dependent and learnable
6fa7fe0ab3.zh: • 信任与可信性是非对称双向的、依赖情境的，并且可以学习

d587d987ec.en: • Six attributes of trustworthy systems: resilience, security, privacy, safety, reliability, availability
d587d987ec.zh: • 可信系统的六个属性：韧性、安全性（security）、隐私、安全（safety）、可靠性、可用性

557bd0530d.en: • AI ethics is hierarchical (individual / society / environment); map each principle to a technique — transparency→explainable AI, fairness→fair AI, non-maleficence→safe/robust AI, privacy→federated/differential learning
557bd0530d.zh: • AI 伦理是分层的（个人/社会/环境）；将每条原则对应到一种技术：透明性→可解释 AI，公平性→公平 AI，不作恶→安全/鲁棒 AI，隐私→联邦/差分学习

896e2299c9.en: • 20+ fairness metrics in five families; feature-attribution explanations judged by faithfulness, sensitivity and complexity
896e2299c9.zh: • 5 大类共 20 多种公平性指标；特征归因解释按忠实性、敏感性和复杂度来评判

af0757412e.en: • A multi-objective evolutionary method (MOFAE) optimizes explanations across metrics; evolutionary constrained learning regulates ML behavior
af0757412e.zh: • 多目标进化方法（MOFAE）在多个指标上优化解释；进化式约束学习用于规范机器学习的行为

6a3c3399c0.en: • Evolutionary computation is a promising engine for fair, explainable and safe AI
6a3c3399c0.zh: • 进化计算是实现公平、可解释和安全 AI 的有前景的引擎

d895c8fed8.zh: 洞察 06 · 可信与认知 AI

c41a2bb027.en: Fujitsu / SEI · data-centric AI quality assurance
c41a2bb027.zh: Fujitsu / SEI · 以数据为中心的 AI 质量保证

0a8b7b47c5.zh: 一种新的 AI 系统范式

e2830a7906.en: • Modern AI systems combine 30+ AI models and 50+ traditional components (e.g. STT → NLP intent → response generation → TTS); a ‘Universal AI-CPS’ on NVIDIA Omniverse
e2830a7906.zh: • 现代 AI 系统结合了 30 多个 AI 模型和 50 多个传统组件（例如 STT → NLP 意图 → 响应生成 → TTS）；基于 NVIDIA Omniverse 的“Universal AI-CPS”

9c0ada3466.en: • ISR-LLM: an iterative self-refined LLM for long-horizon task planning (ICRA 2024)
9c0ada3466.zh: • ISR-LLM：用于长时程任务规划的迭代自我优化大语言模型（ICRA 2024）

6be209b5d9.en: • Behavior is learned, not specified → explainability is key and new QA methods are needed
6be209b5d9.zh: • 行为是学习得到的，而非预先规定的 → 可解释性是关键，需要新的质量保证方法

1ba21d9e5f.en: • Unit level: quality across the ML lifecycle; DeepGauge test-coverage criteria; data-centric out-of-distribution & uncertainty analysis
1ba21d9e5f.zh: • 单元层面：覆盖整个机器学习生命周期的质量；DeepGauge 测试覆盖准则；以数据为中心的分布外与不确定性分析

bb3bb28cfd.en: • System level: quality assurance and reliability support at integration and system stages
bb3bb28cfd.zh: • 系统层面：在集成和系统阶段提供质量保证与可靠性支持

587a82d32a.en: • Human-centered, explainable MLSysOps across data, model, code and system
587a82d32a.zh: • 以人为中心、可解释的 MLSysOps，覆盖数据、模型、代码和系统

f8635342f5.zh: 生成式 AI / 大语言模型保障

c3d3352cb2.en: • LLM trustworthiness is at a very early stage; internals are hard to test and debug
c3d3352cb2.zh: • 大语言模型的可信性尚处于很早期的阶段；其内部机制难以测试和调试

657535096b.en: • Tools: the LUNA model-analysis framework; LLM-agent orchestration decomposed into Profile, Memory, Planning and Action
657535096b.zh: • 工具：LUNA 模型分析框架；大语言模型智能体编排被分解为 Profile、Memory、Planning 和 Action

9aa32a923c.zh: 洞察 07 · 可信与认知 AI

9496a82a61.en: • A formal abstract system S ≜ (C, B, Rᶜ, Rᵇ, Rᶠ, Rⁱ, Rᵒ): components, behaviors and internal/external relation sets
9496a82a61.zh: • 形式化抽象系统 S ≜ (C, B, Rᶜ, Rᵇ, Rᶠ, Rⁱ, Rᵒ)：组件、行为以及内部/外部关系集

b79656967a.en: • Abstract intelligence transfers information / knowledge into behavior
b79656967a.zh: • 抽象智能将信息/知识转化为行为

048a042076.en: • System autonomy by cognitive × behavioral axes: reflexive, imperative, adaptive, autonomous — autonomous intelligence is the 4th (quaternary) level
048a042076.zh: • 按认知 × 行为两个维度划分系统自主性：反射式、命令式、自适应、自主——自主智能是第 4 级（四元）水平

cbcd7e30cc.en: • Machine thinking via LRMB (Layered Reference Model of the Brain): sensation, action, perception, memory, cognition, inference, intelligence
cbcd7e30cc.zh: • 通过 LRMB（Layered Reference Model of the Brain，大脑分层参考模型）实现机器思维：感觉、行动、感知、记忆、认知、推断、智能

d3e6f96071.en: • A tripartite model: structural, behavioral and dynamic trustworthiness
d3e6f96071.zh: • 三方模型：结构可信性、行为可信性和动态可信性

665b116e78.en: • A formal model links levels of system intelligence by inclusion
665b116e78.zh: • 一个形式化模型以包含关系连接各级系统智能

f8d826253c.en: INSIGHT 08 · Autonomous systems in the real world
f8d826253c.zh: 洞察 08 · 真实世界中的自主系统

9d6796dbe9.en: Jianping Wang · City University of Hong Kong
9d6796dbe9.zh: Jianping Wang · City University of Hong Kong

227312330f.en: • The AD stack on a driving OS (Apollo 3.5/5.0): perception → localization → prediction → planning → control
227312330f.zh: • 运行在驾驶操作系统（Apollo 3.5/5.0）上的 AD 技术栈：感知 → 定位 → 预测 → 规划 → 控制

7ccc690f79.en: • Vulnerabilities: perception-model uncertainty, dynamic per-module compute time, and adverse weather (fog/rain/snow degrade cameras, LiDAR and comms)
7ccc690f79.zh: • 脆弱性：感知模型的不确定性、各模块动态变化的计算时间，以及恶劣天气（雾/雨/雪会降低摄像头、LiDAR 和通信的性能）

7dd83527f4.en: • Hardware limits → edge computing; software (model uncertainty, timing) → digital twins & cooperative sensing
7dd83527f4.zh: • 硬件限制 → 边缘计算；软件（模型不确定性、时序）→ 数字孪生与协同感知

1739e72136.en: • Attacks (physical / adversarial / cyber) → robust driving; adverse weather → robust V2X
1739e72136.zh: • 攻击（物理/对抗/网络）→ 鲁棒驾驶；恶劣天气 → 鲁棒 V2X

128564f78b.en: • Adversarial-attack-aware motion planning stays safe where naive planning fails; multi-agent prediction + camera/LiDAR/radar fusion handle occlusion
128564f78b.zh: • 具备对抗攻击感知的运动规划在朴素规划失效的情况下仍能保持安全；多智能体预测加上摄像头/LiDAR/雷达融合可应对遮挡

92219f1eda.en: • Onboard scheduling uses an Age-of-Information metric and an RL agent (reward ∝ 1/AoI), improving miss ratio and response vs Apollo baselines
92219f1eda.zh: • 车载调度使用信息年龄（Age-of-Information）指标和强化学习（RL）智能体（奖励 ∝ 1/AoI），相比 Apollo 基线改善了错失率和响应

efa09568b7.en: INSIGHT 09 · Autonomous systems in the real world
efa09568b7.zh: 洞察 09 · 真实世界中的自主系统

fa8611c775.en: Naira Hovakimyan · University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
fa8611c775.zh: Naira Hovakimyan · University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

dd82fa2315.en: • Safety-critical systems need guarantees because failures can be deadly; safely obtaining training data is hard
dd82fa2315.zh: • 安全关键系统需要保证，因为失效可能致命；安全地获取训练数据很困难

379908820a.en: • Control-theoretic tools (structured, deterministic) are strong on safety/robustness; ML tools (general, stochastic) are strong on empirical performance
379908820a.zh: • 控制理论工具（结构化、确定性）在安全性/鲁棒性方面很强；机器学习工具（通用、随机性）在经验性能方面很强

0e452f6f4a.en: • Train-vs-real distribution shift can break the control objective; control the size of the guaranteed set, or be agnostic to the training distribution
0e452f6f4a.zh: • 训练分布与真实分布的偏移可能破坏控制目标；可以控制有保证集合的大小，或者对训练分布保持无关

856d82a7e1.en: • Distributionally robust optimization with finite samples; verified by Monte-Carlo; incremental stochastic stability
856d82a7e1.zh: • 有限样本下的分布鲁棒优化；通过蒙特卡洛方法验证；增量随机稳定性

f6df26674a.zh: L1 自适应控制 + 学习

7cbc9d77de.en: • L1 adaptive control gives guaranteed uniform performance bounds, decoupling estimation from control (small-gain + Lyapunov)
7cbc9d77de.zh: • L1 自适应控制提供有保证的一致性能界，将估计与控制解耦（小增益 + Lyapunov）

75c8c0f589.en: • Commercialized with NASA, Caterpillar and JOUAV; extended via contraction metrics, L1-MPC, and contraction-L1 with Gaussian-process learning
75c8c0f589.zh: • 已与 NASA、Caterpillar 和 JOUAV 实现商业化；通过收缩度量、L1-MPC，以及结合高斯过程学习的 contraction-L1 得到扩展

204a5a32cc.en: INSIGHT 10 · Autonomous systems in the real world
204a5a32cc.zh: 洞察 10 · 真实世界中的自主系统

dff6329020.en: • An integrated multi-physics, multi-scale, probabilistic simulation updated by sensors (NASA 2012); a digital replica that improves decision-making (CDBB 2018)
dff6329020.zh: • 由传感器更新的集成式多物理、多尺度、概率仿真（NASA 2012）；能改进决策的数字副本（CDBB 2018）

66cb87c215.en: • A twin should see, learn, think, act, communicate, cooperate and achieve
66cb87c215.zh: • 孪生体应能看、学、想、行动、通信、协作并达成目标

38277fd25f.en: • Connected assets help each other ‘in times of trouble’ via shared information / computation — faster, coordinated recovery
38277fd25f.zh: • 互联的资产通过共享信息/计算在“危难之时”互相帮助——更快、更协调地恢复

8bc588ed92.en: • Spans robotics, AI, V2X, perception and blockchain across cyber-physical and cyber-cyber systems
8bc588ed92.zh: • 涵盖机器人、AI、V2X、感知和区块链，跨越信息物理系统与纯信息系统

c86364683c.en: • Japan’s FUKUI self-driving public transit; an Oct 2023 incident where an AV failed to stop and collided, triggering new safety measures
c86364683c.zh: • 日本的 FUKUI 自动驾驶公共交通；2023 年 10 月一起自动驾驶车辆未能停车并发生碰撞的事故，促使出台新的安全措施

9227fafd25.en: INSIGHT 11 · Autonomous systems in the real world
9227fafd25.zh: 洞察 11 · 真实世界中的自主系统

9c744aa084.zh: Andrea Belz · 研究组合分析

9a53258721.en: • An NLP pipeline compiles and augments abstracts, clusters research portfolios, then evaluates clusters and removes redundancy
9a53258721.zh: • 一条 NLP 流水线汇集并扩充摘要，对研究组合进行聚类，然后评估聚类并去除冗余

61699b6a86.en: • Pipeline: documents → YAKE keywords → Mistral-7B metadata → Sentence-Transformer embeddings → labeled clusters (optics, flight system, remote sensing…)
61699b6a86.zh: • 流水线：文档 → YAKE 关键词 → Mistral-7B 元数据 → Sentence-Transformer 嵌入 → 带标签的聚类（光学、飞行系统、遥感……）

4ab113b4b9.en: • Too few clusters = poor coverage; too many = overlap
4ab113b4b9.zh: • 聚类太少 = 覆盖不足；太多 = 重叠

cb9aa8cbcf.en: • A new redundancy measure R = max cosine similarity between label vectors, plotted vs the number of clusters to pick the knee
cb9aa8cbcf.zh: • 一种新的冗余度量 R = 标签向量之间的最大余弦相似度，随聚类数量变化作图以找出拐点

ea11615361.en: • A k×ĉ coverage matrix yields coverage scores / predicted labels when similarity exceeds a threshold (MMR)
ea11615361.zh: • 当相似度超过阈值（MMR）时，k×ĉ 覆盖矩阵给出覆盖得分/预测标签

3c3e5cf4e4.en: • Classical dependability tools (RBD, fault trees, Markov chains, combinatorial testing, probabilistic model checking) are being combined with data-driven methods — not replaced.
3c3e5cf4e4.zh: • 经典的可依赖性工具（RBD、故障树、马尔可夫链、组合测试、概率模型检测）正在与数据驱动方法结合，而不是被取代。

0105d851a5.en: • Distribution shift and uncertainty quantification recur across the control, testing and LLM talks.
0105d851a5.zh: • 分布偏移和不确定性量化在控制、测试和大语言模型的报告中反复出现。

44b78a7036.en: • Autonomous driving is the shared case study grounding abstract reliability and safety methods.
44b78a7036.zh: • 自动驾驶是共同的案例研究，使抽象的可靠性与安全方法落地。

f2d5757a8e.en: • Trustworthiness — resilience, security, privacy, safety, reliability, availability, fairness, explainability — is the gate for deploying AI.
f2d5757a8e.zh: • 可信性——韧性、安全性（security）、隐私、安全（safety）、可靠性、可用性、公平性、可解释性——是部署 AI 的门槛。

bfed3f42c0.en: • Self-aware, cooperative systems: self-healing degradation, cognitive autonomy models, and collaborative digital twins.
bfed3f42c0.zh: • 自感知、协作的系统：自愈式退化、认知自主模型和协作式数字孪生。

96a8b81e7b.en: • Formal and guaranteed methods (L1 control, model checking) scaled to data-driven systems.
96a8b81e7b.zh: • 形式化和有保证的方法（L1 控制、模型检测）扩展到数据驱动系统。

6fd54e7eff.en: • Treat explainability and formal / guaranteed methods as prerequisites, not add-ons (L1 guarantees, PAT/SLAM, DeepGauge, LUNA).
6fd54e7eff.zh: • 将可解释性以及形式化/有保证的方法视为前提条件，而不是附加项（L1 保证、PAT/SLAM、DeepGauge、LUNA）。

801f7e2173.en: • Govern the ML lifecycle with data-centric quality assurance and out-of-distribution analysis.
801f7e2173.zh: • 用以数据为中心的质量保证和分布外分析来管理机器学习生命周期。

15e9e16fe4.en: • GenAI / LLM assurance is immature — the biggest open frontier is testing agentic systems whose behavior is learned, not specified.
15e9e16fe4.zh: • 生成式 AI / 大语言模型保障尚不成熟——最大的开放前沿是测试行为靠学习而非预先规定的智能体系统。
